server measures JSON(body) and calls requestGovernor.before(meta.chars)
qwenV3Capabilities.applyPrepared then prepends selected skill context and owner/engineer application prompt
risk: Per-account inflight token reservation and request-size pressure are computed before up to 60000 owner-prompt characters and up to 32000 selected-skill characters are injected. This weakens the governor exactly when Qwen Core durable owner authority and Qwen Reliability pressure controls are combined.
candidate_contract: Keep requestGovernor before chatAdapter.preparePublicPayload because preparePublicPayload may generate a remote Qwen chat id.
Before governor admission, add the exact UTF-8 byte count of text that applyPrepared will inject later.
Compute that count through existing skills.appendSkillContext + applySystemPromptMode on a synthetic empty message so wrapper bytes and engineer/owner mode stay exact.
Do not persist or log the private owner prompt; only its byte length participates in pressure accounting.
required_regression: Owner mode with a 60000-char prompt plus 32000 chars of selected skills and a tiny user turn must enter the >=50000-char governor estimate bucket before any qwenClient/generateChatID provider work. Engineer/no-skill small requests must preserve current behavior.
scope_limits: No qwen-free-api product file changed by INTEGRATION_HELPER.
No hosted CI, provider traffic, accounts, secrets, Windows, Cloudflare or production used.
